_note: Structural probe check definitions for tech-design. Loaded via $FETCH_COMPOSE --role structural-probe-criteria. Each check maps to a gap_kind=structural item when triggered; repair_class is always mechanical. The mechanical_fixer.py whitelist determines whether auto-fix applies; unhandled items degrade to kw_subsection.

checks.description: Section heading is present in document but the <!-- section-key:KEY --> anchor comment is absent or KEY mismatches the registered section_key.
checks.intent_gap_template: Section {section_key} is missing its <!-- section-key:{section_key} --> anchor comment, or the comment key does not match the registry.

checks.description: Top-level section heading is not H2, or a sub-section heading depth does not match the compose-template declaration (expected H3).
A sub-section declared as required in section-kw-criteria (KW0 level) is entirely absent from the section body.
checks.intent_gap_template: Required sub-section '{subsection_title}' is missing from section {section_key}.

checks.description: Sub-section body contains unreplaced placeholder or TODO text (e.g. 'TODO', '<!-- TODO -->', '(placeholder)', 'TBD') with no other substantive content.
checks.intent_gap_template: Sub-section '{subsection_title}' in {section_key} contains only a placeholder and has not been filled in.
